note: Coordinates: restaurant coordinates are street-level OpenStreetMap geocodes (house numbers are not resolved in Shanghai, so expect ±1 km) except Taian Table, which uses the coordinate MICHELIN publishes on its own page. Hotel coordinates are OpenStreetMap building/polygon centroids. Because of that error margin, treat any two hotels whose counts differ by 1–2 restaurants as tied. No live journey-planner output was obtainable in this environment (Google/Apple/Baidu transit and Overpass were unreachable), so the 60-minute test is a banding device, not a measured trip.
